workspace.voice.cannotRecord: This window cannot record: GStreamer’s plugins for the microphone are missing.
workspace.voice.gaveNothing: The microphone gave nothing: check it is the one chosen above.
workspace.voice.title: Voice messages
workspace.voice.hint: Speak to a chat: the words land in its composer, to read before sending.
workspace.voice.more: The microphone sits beside the paperclip in a chat’s composer ({attach} attaches files); a terminal has neither. Click or hold it to speak, or hold {talk} while the chat is in front (Settings → Keyboard changes the key). Without an engine the recording goes as a file. Nothing is sent anywhere unless {service} is chosen here.
workspace.voice.stillNone: Still no whisper on this machine.
workspace.voice.none: No whisper found on this machine.
workspace.voice.installCpp: {name}: {cli} on the PATH, {ffmpeg} beside it, and a model file such as {file} from the whisper.cpp releases, chosen here.
workspace.voice.installPip: {name}: {pip} (or {alt}), which fetches its {base} model the first time.
workspace.voice.downloadTitle: ggml-base.bin from whisper.cpp's releases, about 150 MB, into ~/.devpit/models
workspace.voice.findTitle: Opens the microphone for an instant: the system lists and names them only then
workspace.telegram.privacyMinimal: Only that something waits or was answered
workspace.telegram.privacyTitles: Which session, card or project, and the first line of an answer
workspace.telegram.privacyFull: Names, and the orchestrator’s whole answer
workspace.telegram.throughDevpit: Notices go to the chat you linked through devpit.app, which passes on only what you let it and keeps none of it; what you write there goes to your orchestrator as you while devpit is open, and waits ten minutes for it at most. Sending a draft, stopping a session or starting a lane’s step waits for a button there. Telegram is not end-to-end encrypted: what a message says, Telegram can read.
workspace.telegram.direct: Notices go to the chat you linked, and what you write or say there goes to your orchestrator as you. Sending a draft, stopping a session or starting a lane’s step waits for a button there. Telegram is not end-to-end encrypted: what a message says, Telegram can read.
workspace.telegram.makeBot: Make a bot with @BotFather and paste its token here. It is kept on this computer, readable by you alone, and never shown again.
workspace.telegram.sendCode: Now send {cmd} to @{bot} from the chat devpit should use
workspace.telegram.codeHolds: . The code holds for ten minutes.
workspace.telegram.devpitHint: No bot to make: devpit.app carries it, and by default says only that something waits.
workspace.general.localHint: Projects, conversations and settings are kept on this computer.
workspace.general.autoUpdatesSaid: Check in the background and offer to install.
workspace.general.errorReportsSaid: Send devpit’s own errors, without paths or your work, anonymously and only while devpit sits idle. Turning it off deletes what was kept.
workspace.general.remindersSaid: A card's date goes off at its time, as a banner here and a notification.
workspace.general.remindersMore: A date with no time goes off at nine that morning. An agent can set one when you ask it to remind you.
workspace.general.focusSaid: Unfinished. A door for one project: what arrives from another waits until you come out.
workspace.general.confirmStopSaid: A terminal still running something asks before it is closed. Its “Don’t ask again” turns this off; this turns it back on.
workspace.sync.title: Sync between machines
workspace.sync.said: Preferences and project settings follow you to your other computers, sealed here with a key devpit.app never sees. Paths, windows, remote access and the vault’s secrets stay on each computer.
workspace.sync.signInFirst: Sign in above first: the account is what joins your computers.
workspace.sync.joinHint: This account already syncs from another computer. There, open Settings → Account → Sync and press {pair}, then paste what it shows here — or type the recovery code you wrote down.
workspace.sync.startOverConfirm: Delete what this account synced and start again from this computer? Every other computer stops syncing until it is joined again.
workspace.sync.offerHint: On the other computer, signed in to this account, paste this in Settings → Account → Sync. It works once, for two minutes.
workspace.sync.recoveryHint: Write the recovery code down: it is the key, and the way back in if every computer is lost.
workspace.decisions.title: Decisions
workspace.decisions.hint: Yes/no, a choice or a score, each with a calibrated confidence — asked by devpit and its agents, answered by Jev.
workspace.decisions.offUntilKey: Off until a key is kept.
workspace.decisions.more: Every state passes through devpit’s redaction first, every request asks for zero retention and no training, and the day’s cap stops it. Without a key, the network or budget, everything works as it does without it. Agents reach it as {decide} and {rubric}.
workspace.decisions.sendStateSaid: Off keeps this project’s cards, diffs and output from ever reaching Decisions; its gates then do what they did without it.
workspace.view.sendWithSaid: Enter sends and Shift+Enter starts a new line, or Enter starts a new line and {other} sends.
workspace.view.whileTurnSaid: What a message sent during a turn does: waits for the turn to end, or goes into it now.
workspace.view.textSizeSaid: The conversation’s text and its controls.
workspace.view.codeSizeSaid: Code blocks and code in a line, and every diff.
workspace.view.contrastSaid: More draws secondary text and borders closer to the main text.
workspace.view.latexSaid: Draws {inline} and {block} in answers and Markdown files as formulas. Off, a dollar sign is just a dollar sign.
workspace.view.diffLayoutSaid: How a diff opens. Each view keeps its own toggle; by default a file’s diff opens side by side and a commit’s stacked.
workspace.view.whitespaceSaid: Hide lines whose only change is spacing, in a commit’s and a card’s changes.
workspace.view.coloursSaid: Blue and orange instead of green and red, told apart with red-green colour blindness.
workspace.view.filesSaid: Whether each file of a card’s or a session’s changes opens folded.
workspace.keyboard.toProgram: Inside a terminal the key goes to the program.
workspace.keyboard.note: {keys} shows them all at a glance. A key you record works at once; one with no Ctrl, Alt or ⌘ never fires while you type.
workspace.keyboard.press: Press the keys — Esc to stop
workspace.keyboard.bringSaid: A key the whole desktop answers to, set with opening at login.
workspace.maintenance.powerSaverSaid: Background checks run four times less often while nobody is at the window or this machine runs on battery. Off, devpit is balanced, as it always was.
workspace.maintenance.onBattery: This machine is on battery now.
workspace.maintenance.keepSaid: devpit’s logs, and the runs and reviews Devflow keeps for each card. The newest run of each card always stays.
workspace.maintenance.notRun: Not run yet. It also runs on its own, for what is older than {count} days.
workspace.maintenance.projectAgentSaid: Beta. An agent that knows one project. On, it is offered to each project linked to an orchestrator: devpit asks you as a project is linked, and reads a project only once you turn it on for it, below or from its Project agent page. The orchestrator and the project’s sessions ask it, and it draws lessons when a card is done.
workspace.maintenance.agentOn: Learns and answers for this project.
workspace.maintenance.agentOff: Off: no agent learns or answers for this project. On, it learns the project once.
workspace.maintenance.facts: Accept facts that rest only on files in {name}
workspace.maintenance.factsSaid: A fact saved from Ask the project whose sources are all files of the project enters its memory without waiting, marked as accepted automatically and undone from its page, as the facts its own read finds do. Lessons and decisions always wait for you.
workspace.maintenance.canvasSaid: Beta. The Canvas plugin, a whiteboard a project can install. Off, it is not offered.
workspace.assistant.triggerCi: CI fails on an open pull request
workspace.assistant.triggerWaiting: A session is stopped on a question
workspace.assistant.triggerBlocked: A card in progress is blocked
workspace.assistant.note: While an orchestrator’s Assistant mode is on — a toggle in its chat — its heartbeat looks for what needs you. It stays silent when nothing does, and says each thing once, in the bell and on your channels.
workspace.assistantToggle.on: Assistant mode is on — its tools are in this chat now, its brief from the next chat. Click to turn it off
workspace.assistantToggle.off: Assistant mode: Schedules in view and proposals for you to add. Off — click to turn it on
workspace.assistantToggle.label: Assistant mode
workspace.hosts.name: Host name
workspace.hosts.targetHint: an ssh config alias, or a host name
workspace.hosts.title: Hosts
workspace.hosts.note: Machines a project’s terminals can run on, reached with your own ssh: its config, agent and known hosts. devpit keeps the target and a key’s path, never a key, and creates nothing on a host.
workspace.calendar.title: Calendar
workspace.calendar.said: Card dates and reminders as a calendar Google Calendar, Apple Calendar or Outlook can subscribe to, served by devpit.app from what this computer sends it.
workspace.calendar.signIn: Sign in to devpit.app on this computer first (Settings → Account).
workspace.calendar.titles: Show titles — otherwise every event reads “devpit reminder”, and no card’s words leave this computer
workspace.calendar.anyone: Anyone with the link can read the calendar. {reset} and the old one stops working.
workspace.guardrail.stopSaid: The orchestrator ends a session and closes its terminal.
workspace.guardrail.force: Force stop, or a stop that loses work
workspace.guardrail.forceSaid: The session is working, or its folder has changes not committed.
workspace.guardrail.send: Send a drafted reply as you
workspace.guardrail.sendSaid: A reply the orchestrator wrote goes to a session in your name.
workspace.guardrail.none: No orchestrator yet: its guardrails show here once you create one.
workspace.guardrail.title: Guardrails
workspace.guardrail.note: What the orchestrator waits for you to confirm. Follow chat permission asks unless its chat runs in Full access. Done without asking, it says so in its chat and in its sessions log.
workspace.guardrail.orchestratorLabel: The orchestrator these guardrails are for
workspace.desk.loginSaid: devpit starts with your desktop, so the island and the reminders are there from the first minute.
workspace.desk.loginMore: One copy runs at a time: opening devpit again brings this one forward.
workspace.desk.tray: Keep devpit in the tray when the window closes
workspace.desk.traySaid: Closing the window leaves devpit running, so your agents still reach you. Quit it from the tray’s menu.
workspace.desk.trayMore: The icon counts what waits on you — sessions stopped on a question, drafts to send, reminders gone off — and its menu opens each one, your recent projects, a new terminal and Settings.
workspace.desk.noTray: This desktop shows no tray icon, so closing the window quits devpit. The terminals keep running either way.
workspace.desk.press: Press the keys — Escape to stop.
workspace.desk.none: Keys that bring devpit forward from anywhere. None yet.
workspace.island.above: Here it sits at the top of the screen, above every window.
workspace.island.layer: Here it is a layer at the top of the screen, over the panel, and never takes the keyboard.
workspace.island.plain: On this desktop it can only be an ordinary window, placed where the desktop puts it: GNOME has no layers, and elsewhere it needs gtk-layer-shell installed. So it stays off unless you show it anyway.
workspace.island.title: Island
workspace.island.said: A small window showing what every agent is doing and who is waiting on you.
workspace.island.more: A session’s question shows its choices as buttons, and {reply} answers it in words without opening its terminal. Drag it to another screen to keep it there.
workspace.island.anywaySaid: Off on this desktop: here it can take focus from the window you are in, and stand in for devpit’s own when you switch back. Sessions waiting on you still reach you as notifications.
workspace.scoped.everyProject: Every project without its own; empty is {fallback}.
workspace.hub.title: devpit.app — e-mail and push
workspace.hub.said: devpit.app e-mails what waits on you and wakes your phone; choose which at {account}. A button pressed there is done here, when this computer is on.
workspace.hub.signIn: Sign in to devpit.app on this computer first (Settings → Account).
workspace.hub.titles: Say which session, card or project — e-mail is not end-to-end encrypted
workspace.community.label: Community
workspace.community.title: The devpit community on Discord
workspace.telegram.name: Telegram
workspace.schedules.title: Schedules
workspace.schedules.intro: Every reminder this orchestrator reaches and every routine you set. Only you schedule: what the orchestrator proposes waits here for your click.
workspace.schedules.delete.label: Delete {title}
workspace.schedules.routine.label: Routine
workspace.schedules.proposed.label: Proposed by the orchestrator
workspace.memory.standing.off: Off for this project: its agent neither learns nor answers until you turn it on.
workspace.memory.standing.learning: Learning the project: facts that rest on its files enter the memory, the rest waits here for you.
workspace.memory.standing.learned: Learned the project on {day}. Facts that rest on its files entered the memory; the rest waits for your approval.
workspace.memory.standing.not: Not learned yet: Re-learn has its agent read the project.
workspace.memory.belongs: The project agent belongs to a project.
workspace.capDialog.uninstalledKept: {name} uninstalled. Its files stay in this project’s folder.
workspace.capDialog.filesUnknown: Everything it saved in this project’s folder.
workspace.capDialog.filesNone: It has no files in this project’s folder yet.
workspace.capDialog.installBody: Installs {name} in this project and turns it on. {bold}
workspace.capDialog.installBold: Its files will live in this project’s folder.
workspace.capDialog.leaves: {name} leaves the sidebar and {bold}. You can install it again from here.
workspace.capDialog.unlessTick: Unless you tick the box, they stay in this project’s folder.
workspace.plugins.title: Capabilities
workspace.plugins.note: Built into devpit, installed per project. On, a capability gets its own place in the sidebar; off, it leaves and its files stay.
workspace.plugins.noMatchDetail: Try another word, or show all.
workspace.mcp.title: MCPs
workspace.mcp.note: Read from the agent CLI’s own config — devpit keeps no second copy. Add or remove one with {command} and it changes here.
workspace.mcp.fine: Nothing is wrong with devpit; the CLI has none configured yet.
workspace.mcpApp.askLabel: The page wants to run a tool
workspace.mcpChip.title: MCP servers
workspace.mcpChip.head: MCP servers · {profile}
workspace.channels.title: Channels
workspace.channels.plus: A devpit bot that works with this computer off, and more, come with devpit Plus.
workspace.channels.delayNote: With a delay, a notice goes to its first channel — push, then Telegram, then e-mail — and moves to the next while nobody answers the session, sends the draft, deals with the reminder or presses one of its buttons. Channels you have not set up are skipped. It moves on from this computer: while it is off or asleep, nothing moves on.
workspace.channels.sendNothing: Send nothing during these hours — a reminder you set still goes
workspace.channels.noDay: No day ticked is every day.
workspace.channels.gatherNote: What happens within this long goes as one message: five sessions finishing at once are one notice.
workspace.manager.title: Manager
workspace.manager.intro: Every project’s board, in one place. Opening a card goes to it.
workspace.manager.none: No projects yet. Add one and its board shows up here.
workspace.skills.searched: Names and descriptions are both searched.
workspace.skills.arrive: Skills arrive with the plugins you install for the agent CLI.
workspace.skillPills.label: Skills

workspace.diagnostics.totals.one: {count} process, {cpu} of a core, {memory} of memory.
workspace.diagnostics.totals.other: {count} processes, {cpu} of a core, {memory} of memory.

workspace.diagnostics.nothingLogged: Nothing logged. Error reports keep this log while they are on.
workspace.capRows.title: Capabilities
workspace.pluginChip.offerTitle: Gives every Claude Code session in a devpit terminal the board's tools and devpit's hooks
workspace.pluginChip.done: devpit plugin ready — run /reload-plugins in Claude Code
workspace.pluginChip.failed: The plugin could not be installed
workspace.pluginChip.whyDefault: the plugin could not be installed
workspace.learn.question: Turn on learning for this project?
workspace.learn.why: Its agent reads the project once and keeps what it learns for the orchestrator and its sessions. Nothing reads it until you turn it on.
workspace.learn.label: Project learning

workspace.browserMenu.signedOut: “{session}” was signed out. It is holding nothing now.
workspace.browserMenu.limitImport: Limit the import to one site
workspace.browserMenu.noProfiles: devpit found no browser profiles on this machine.
workspace.browserMenu.profileNote: A profile is read whole and only what is named above is kept. Nothing is imported until a profile is picked.
workspace.browserMenu.widthNote: A width, not a device: the page is held narrower. Its user agent and touch support do not change.
workspace.browserMenu.drive: Let an agent drive this page
workspace.browserMenu.driveOn: On. What it does is said in the pane as it happens.

workspace.browserMenu.signOutUsed: Removes {kb} KB — its cookies, storage and logins. The other sessions are untouched.
workspace.browserMenu.signOutEmpty: This session is holding nothing yet.

workspace.checked.again: What running this again would do
workspace.checked.recordedNothing: This run recorded nothing about itself. Runs from before devpit kept this cannot say what they ran or against which code.

workspace.worktreeCleanup.said: Once a card's commits are in the default branch, its worktree, build cache and local branch go. One with uncommitted work, or a session running in it, is kept.
